newsitem.title: USA: Philips Q3 net income up 38 pct over Q3 95.
newsitem.headline: Philips Q3 net income up 38 pct over Q3 95.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co reported Wednesday net income for the third quarter of $187 million or 71 cents a share, up from $136 million or 52 cents a share in the third quarter of 1995.
Revenue was up $500 million at $3.9 billion. Net operating profit at $208 million versus $151 million in third quarter 1996 included a $25 million charge for impairment of some Canadian properties.

The 38 percent increase in net income for the quarter over the year earlier quarter "continues a trend of strong quarterly earnings in 1996, setting the stage for an outstanding year," said Wayne Allen, Phillips chairman and chief executive.
"The strong performance also helps provide funding for our expanded capital program to support our growth strategies," Allen said.
For the nine months net income was $1.1 billion or $4.20 a share, up from $360 million or $1.37 a share for the first three quarters in 1995.

The 1996 results were boosted by a $565 million first-quarter exceptional item, the result of the resolution of a tax case involving the company's Kenai, Alaska liquefied natural gas facility. Excluding special items nine-month 1996 operating income was up 42 pct at $639 million versus $450 million in the same period a year earlier.
